title: Page 7
content_zh:
可是，晚上童悠悠回去桂园，梁老夫人却突然病倒了，高热不下，胡言乱语不止，连夜请了大夫，足足喝了三日药才算好一些。
也不知道出于什么心思，梁老夫人居然又把童悠悠这个孙媳妇喊去侍疾。
结果，好似碰巧一般，晚饭前童悠悠回了桂园，梁老夫人就又高热起来，这次更严重，差点没救过来，足足半个月才算好，但身体大不如前，连走路都要丫鬟搀扶。
于是，安南府内和府外渐渐就有了传言，梁家大少奶奶的属相同梁老夫人相冲，只要见面就压制得梁老夫人不安宁。而梁大少爷当初直接把新娘子接回桂园，实际上也是为了孝顺梁老夫人。
不管事实如何，总之梁浩海成功洗白了，成了孝顺长辈又疼爱妻子的好男人表率。
而梁老夫人不知道是不是怕了，再也没派人请孙媳妇进府伺候。
第二十一章 药铺门庭若市(2)
桂园里，微微带了几分凉爽的晚风吹过，露出坐在桂树上赏月的小夫妻俩，互相依偎，甜蜜恩爱，真是羡煞旁人。
“你也真是胆大，万一被人发现，治你一个不孝，你的差事怕是就要丢了。”
“放心，侯府里我安插了不少人手，这点小事还是很稳妥的。就是事发也没什么，不做官更好，我带你去周游全国，看看大山大水，总比关在京都里好。”
“不成，你还是好好当官。我的药铺刚有起色，我还等着赚银子呢！”
“哎呀，我当初就该知道，我娶的是个财迷啊！”
“你才是财迷，干娘和婶子都投了本钱，我总不能让她们跟着赔钱啊。”
“好吧，为了媳妇儿，我只能勉为其难继续做官了。”
小夫妻俩说笑着，不时耳鬓厮磨，羞得月亮都躲进了云层后……
七月初十，一年中最热的时候，即便是京都，不如乡下树多，依旧有众多的知了叫得人心烦。
忙了一上午的人们，吃过午饭，寻个阴凉之处，随便一躺就呼呼大睡。
妇人们守着孩子，一边闲话一边做针线。最近她们嘴里的新鲜事不是旁的，是徐御史家里的老妻，时隔十年又生产了，这次生的是个大胖小子。听说徐御史欢喜得原本还在上朝，就同皇上请假回家去了。皇上宽仁，不但没责怪，还给了不少赏赐。
今日是徐家小子的洗三日子，一早徐家门前可是聚满了马车，宾客进进出出，热闹至极。
童悠悠这个徐家义女，今日当仁不让的接过了管家权，替坐月子的婶子张罗小兄弟的洗三礼。

她挽了简单的发髻，插了两支珍珠钗，一身浅蓝色衣裙，如此炎热之日看着就凉爽，配上她温柔的眉眼，浅浅的笑意，真是让厅堂里小坐的各家妇人们看了越发喜爱。
“梁夫人嫁人之后，这身体倒是一日比一日好了。”
“可不是吗，人逢喜事精神爽，这女子啊，就是需要人疼，日子好了，什么病都没了。”
嬷嬷已经收起水盆等物，这会儿，徐大娘怀里抱了被折腾得掉眼泪的胖小子，笑得合不拢嘴，听了这话就道：“你们是不知道，悠悠啊，可是个好孩子，我们家里能添这个大胖小子都是她的功劳呢！”
说实话，徐夫人虽然平日交往很多朋友，但绝对没有今日赶来的这么多，很大一部分是好奇她老蚌怀珠，有没有什么秘方，跑来试探。
没想到，徐大娘居然主动说起，自然惹得众人赶紧问个不停——
“大夫人，我们平日也常来常往，不是外人，您可别吊我们胃口，赶紧同我们说说。”
“是啊，大夫人，我家儿媳进门四年没开怀，难不成梁夫人有什么生子秘方给了徐夫人不成？”
徐大娘就喊了童悠悠上前，笑道：“说起来，真是没什么秘方，全是悠悠的功劳。你们不知道，悠悠在我们台州就小有名气，若不是童老夫人规矩严格，悠悠就是到药铺当坐堂大夫都成。我同她一路到京都，路上结缘，做了她的义母，我家弟妹是个心善的，对悠悠也好，悠悠就出手给她调理身体，不过小半年，我弟妹就怀上了。如今果然生了个大胖小子，我们徐家算是有后，悠悠就是我们徐家的大恩人啊！”
众人听了惊奇，她们知道徐家妯娌同这位梁夫人一起开了家药铺，看的是女子病症，这时候听徐大娘这么说，免不得就有几分老王卖瓜的嫌疑，更何况先前童悠悠自己就病倒厉害，还传出不能生养的消息。
徐大娘也不傻，见状就道：“悠悠啊，年轻天真，虽说一身本事，但架不住有心人算计啊！先前也真是病得厉害，后来还是嫁了人才好起来。我也说不清楚，还是让悠悠自己说几句。”
童悠悠笑道：“我师从宫里告老回乡的王明仁太医，原本是为了能更好的照顾生病的祖母，后来越学越喜欢，就潜心研究了几年。不敢说精通女子疾病，但比起普通大夫还是多了几分熟悉。先前回京，突然病倒，怎么都诊治不好，也是懊恼，出嫁之后，还是夫君派人到台州请教我师傅，拿了药方回来，我才慢慢调理好。若是各位夫人也有这方面的困扰，可以来药铺寻我。”
“王太医，可是宫里那位最擅长治疗妇人和孩子病症的王太医？原来他的老家在台州，我先前还寻人没少打听呢！”
“我也是，没想到，王大夫回乡收了位高徒。”
“梁夫人，劳烦您给我诊诊脉吧，先前看过大夫说我宫寒，但我实在想再生一个孩子……”
人的名，树的影儿，王大夫的招牌打出来，所有人立刻去了疑心，围上前，差点儿把童悠悠淹没。
幸好，还有聪明的，开口帮忙解围，“今日是徐夫人的大喜日子，咱们啊，还是喝杯喜酒重要。左右梁夫人的药铺开在那里，也躲不掉，咱们明日再上门就是。”
众人这才惊觉有些失礼，赶紧笑道：“哎呀，倒是我们心急了，那就约明日，到时候咱们去药铺再说。”
这般，大伙才散了开来，即便还有些心不在焉，惦记自己是否也能像徐夫人一般生个大胖小子，但总算还记得来此的正事。
前院里，徐庭派人来抱儿子，没少同人显摆。梁浩海赶来喝喜酒，被他拉着敬了一杯又一杯，完全没了往日冷肃的模样，喝得大醉。

第二日，取名叫慈安堂的小药铺里，突然由门可罗雀，变得门庭若市。
因为一次来了几十个患者，童悠悠不得不发放一些写有标号的木牌，劝回大半的看诊之人。
妇人的病症，尤其涉及到怀孕，根源很复杂，询问也特别仔细，一个病人往往就要大半个时辰。
而当初她过来坐诊，梁浩海唯一的要求就是只忙半日，下午要歇息。
所以，童悠悠一上午只能接诊五个病人，其余必须等待叫号。幸好，妇人的病症除了难产，倒也不怕耽搁这么几日。
当然也有人乘兴而来，败兴而归，免不得说几句难听的。童悠悠没放在心上，口碑是靠实力铸就的，不是依靠甜言蜜语哄得所有人高兴。
药铺门面不大，后边却很宽敞，有单独的检查室，还有产房、药材仓库，甚至是喝茶等候之地，安排得很是仔细周全。
过来看诊的妇人先前还有些羞涩，毕竟有些检查手段，可是她们想都不敢想的，但童悠悠神色严肃，对病症诊断极准确，让她们愿意忍着羞臊，赌一赌那个希望。
content_en:
However, when Tong Youyou returned to Guiyuan in the evening, Mrs. Liang suddenly fell ill. She had a high fever and kept talking nonsense. She invited a doctor overnight and drank medicine for three days before she felt better.
For some unknown reason, Mrs. Liang actually called Tong Youyou, her granddaughter-in-law, to attend to her illness.
As a result, as if by chance, Tong Youyou returned to Guiyuan before dinner, and Mrs. Liang fell into a high fever again. This time it was more serious, and she almost didn't survive. It took half a month to recover, but her health was not as good as before, and she had to be helped by the maid even to walk.
As a result, rumors gradually spread both inside and outside the Annan Mansion that the eldest mistress of the Liang family had a conflicting zodiac sign with Mrs. Liang, and whenever they met, she would suppress Mrs. Liang and make her restless. When Young Master Liang took his bride back to Guiyuan, it was actually to show his filial piety to Mrs. Liang.
No matter what the facts are, Liang Haohai has successfully cleared his name and has become an example of a good man who is filial to his elders and loves his wife.
Mrs. Liang didn't know if she was afraid, so she never sent anyone to invite her granddaughter-in-law into the house to serve her.
Chapter 21 The drug store is bustling with people (2)
In the osmanthus garden, a slightly cool evening breeze blew through, revealing the young couple sitting on the laurel tree admiring the moon, cuddling each other, sweet and loving, which really made others envious.
"You are really brave. If someone finds out and punishes you for being unfilial, I'm afraid your job will be lost."
"Don't worry, I have deployed a lot of people in the Hou Mansion. This little thing is still very safe. Even if the incident happens, it won't matter. It is better not to be an official. I will take you to travel around the country and see the mountains and rivers. It is better than being locked up in Kyoto."
"No, you'd better be a good official. My pharmacy has just started to improve, and I'm still waiting to make money!"
"Oh, I should have known from the beginning that I married a money addict!"
"You are the one who is obsessed with money. My godmother and aunt have both invested their money. I can't let them lose money."
"Well, for the sake of my wife, I can only reluctantly continue to be an official."
The young couple chatted and laughed, whispering together from time to time, so embarrassed that the moon hid behind the clouds...
On the tenth day of July, the hottest time of the year, even in Kyoto, where there are not as many trees as in the countryside, there are still so many cicadas that are annoying.
People who have been busy all morning, after lunch, find a shady place, lie down and fall asleep.
The women watched over their children, chatting and sewing. The latest news on their lips recently is that Xu Yushi's old wife gave birth again after ten years, and this time she gave birth to a big fat boy. I heard that Xu Yushi was so happy that he was still in court, so he asked for leave and went home with the emperor. The emperor was merciful and not only did not blame, but also gave many rewards.
Today is the third day of the Xu family's boy's bath. Early in the morning, carriages gathered in front of the Xu family's door, and guests came in and out. It was extremely lively.
Tong Youyou, the adopted daughter of the Xu family, took over the housekeeping duties without hesitation today and organized the baptism ceremony for the little brother for her confinement aunt.
She wore a simple bun, two pearl hairpins, and a light blue dress, which looked cool on such a hot day. Coupled with her gentle eyebrows and slight smile, it really made the women sitting in the hall fall in love with her.
"After Mrs. Liang got married, her health got better day by day."
"Isn't that right? People feel refreshed when happy events happen. This woman just needs someone to care for her. Once her life gets better, all her illnesses will be gone."
Grandma had already put away the water basin and other things. At this moment, Aunt Xu held the fat boy in her arms who was in tears due to being tortured. She smiled from ear to ear. After hearing this, she said, "You don't know, Youyou is a good child. It's all thanks to her that we have this big fat boy in our family!"
To be honest, although Mrs. Xu has many friends on weekdays, there are definitely not as many as today. Most of them are curious about whether she has any secret recipes, so she came to try them out.
Unexpectedly, Aunt Xu took the initiative to talk about it, which naturally made everyone hurry up.Keep asking——
"Madam, we come and go frequently on weekdays. We are not outsiders. Please don't tantalize us and talk to us quickly."
"Yes, madam, my daughter-in-law has not been happy for four years since she came in. Is it possible that Mrs. Liang has some secret recipe for giving birth to Mrs. Xu?"
Aunt Xu called Tong Youyou forward and said with a smile: "Speaking of it, there is really no secret recipe, it is all the credit of Youyou. You don't know, Youyou is famous in our Taizhou. If Mrs. Tong hadn't been strict in her rules, Youyou would have been a doctor in a medicine shop. I went to Kyoto with her. , we met on the way and became her adoptive mother. My younger brother and sister are kind-hearted and treat Yuyou well, so she took care of her health. Within half a year, my younger brother and sister finally gave birth to a fat boy. Our Xu family has a daughter, and Youyou is our Xu family’s great benefactor!”
Everyone was surprised when they heard this. They knew that the sisters-in-law of the Xu family had opened a medicine shop with Mrs. Liang, and they were looking for women's illnesses. When Aunt Xu said this, they could not help but be suspected of selling melons to Lao Wang, not to mention that Tong Youyou herself had fallen seriously ill before, and there was news that she could not have children.
Aunt Xu was not stupid. When she saw this, she said: "Yuyou, you are young and naive. Although you are very capable, you can't resist the schemes of others! You were really ill before, but you got better after you got married. I can't explain clearly, so I'll let Youyou say a few words."
Tong Youyou smiled and said: "I studied under Wang Mingren, the imperial doctor who retired from the palace and returned to his hometown. It was originally to take better care of my sick grandmother. Later, the more I learned, the more I liked it, so I studied it for several years. I can't say that I am well-versed in women's diseases, but I am still a little more familiar with it than ordinary doctors. . I suddenly fell ill when I returned to Beijing, and it was frustrating that I couldn't get a good diagnosis and treatment. After I got married, my husband sent someone to Taizhou to consult my master and came back with a prescription. If you ladies also have this problem, you can come to the drugstore to see me. "
"Doctor Wang, who is the best at treating women and children's diseases in the palace? It turns out that his hometown is in Taizhou, and I have been looking for him to inquire about him!"
"Me too. Unexpectedly, Dr. Wang returned to his hometown to take on a high-ranking disciple."
"Mrs. Liang, could you please check my pulse? The doctor told me before that my palace is cold, but I really want to have another child..."
The name of the person, the shadow of the tree, and Dr. Wang's sign were displayed, and everyone immediately lost their suspicion and gathered around, almost drowning Tong Youyou.
Fortunately, there were smart people who opened their mouths to help out, "Today is Mrs. Xu's big day, and it's more important for us to have a wedding drink. Mrs. Liang's medicine shop is spread over there, so we can't hide from her. We'll just come tomorrow."
Only then did everyone realize that it was a bit rude, and they quickly laughed and said: "Oh, we are impatient, so we will make an appointment tomorrow, and then we will go to the drug store to talk about it."
In this way, everyone dispersed. Even though they were still a little absent-minded, wondering whether they could give birth to a fat boy like Mrs. Xu, they still remembered the business of coming here.
In the front yard, Xu Ting sent someone to hold his son, and many of his colleagues showed off. Liang Haohai came over to drink the wedding wine, and he toasted him with one glass after another. He completely lost his usual aloof demeanor and became very drunk.
On the second day, the small medicine shop named Ci'antang suddenly changed from a deserted place to a crowded place.
Because dozens of patients came at one time, Tong Youyou had to hand out some wooden signs with numbers on them to persuade most of the patients to go back.
Women's illnesses, especially those related to pregnancy, have complex causes, and the inquiries must be very careful, often requiring more than half an hour for one patient.
When she came for the consultation, Liang Haohai's only request was that she would only be busy for half a day and rest in the afternoon.
Therefore, Tong Youyou can only see five patients in the morning, and the rest must wait for their number to be called. Fortunately, the woman's illness, apart from dystocia, was not afraid of delaying the delivery for so many days.Of course, there are also people who come here to take advantage of the excitement and return in despair, so they can't help but say a few unpleasant things. Tong Youyou didn't take it to heart. Reputation is built by strength, not by sweet words to make everyone happy.
The drug store has a small front, but it is very spacious in the back. It has a separate examination room, a delivery room, a medicinal material warehouse, and even a waiting place for tea. The arrangements are very careful and thoughtful.
The women who came to see the doctor were a little shy before. After all, there were some examination methods that they couldn't even think of. However, Tong Youyou's serious look and extremely accurate diagnosis of the disease made them willing to endure their shame and gamble on that hope.
